description: Replace the app's allowed web origins (sign-in return URLs and CORS). Each is https://host[:port] or http://localhost:port, no path; at most 10.

app.description: The app's slug or id (from list_apps / create_app).

origins.description: Web origins the app is served from, e.g. https://myapp.example.com or http://localhost:5173 (no path).

name: set_app_origins
